item.title: Livingston County Filing For Committee Positions
item.description: Another candidate has filed for the Livingston County offices on the ballot for the August Primary election. Democrat Mary Ann Scott has filed for the Chillicothe Township Committeewoman position. Democrat Cathleen Kanniainen has filed for the Chillicothe Township Committeewoman position.

item.title: Jail Booking for Livingston County
item.description: Livingston County Deputies booked 52-year-old Davy Lee Norris of Chillicothe on a warrant for alleged failure to appear in court on a charge of alleged driving while revoked or suspended. Bond has been set at $2,500 – cash only.

item.description: Seventy-eight calls for service were handled by the Chillicothe Police Department on Wednesday.
